title: measurement-spec
description: Input contract for aggregate_spec.py (decompose-abstract-to-measurable / Prisma). A value-tree DAG binding an abstract construct to measurable leaves. The LLM authors this; the deterministic script consumes it and never mutates it.

meta.description: context_lock is the Step-0 hard gate — a context-free construct is refused (SpecError).

construct.description: the abstract thing being measured, e.g. 'is this PR healthy?'

context_lock.description: anti-theater Layer 2 binding — a construct is only measurable relative to this (Harnad grounding).

structural_form.description: OPTIONAL — read by structural_route.py. An additive value-tree VALIDLY represents only additive/atomic; relational/gestalt -> BLOCKED; normative/dispositional/temporal -> ASSISTIVE-capped (SAGE v10.7 class matrix).

h35_diagnostics.description: OPTIONAL — 5 concrete yes/no diagnostics structural_route.py uses to DERIVE the form and cross-check it vs the declared structural_form (declared/derived conflict -> REVIEW). Absent while declared additive -> fail-closed (route.status=additive_unverified, capped-assistive).

semantic_loss_estimate.description: OPTIONAL — author self-reported semantic loss (feeds loss_vector; self-report caveat).

R_human.description: OPTIONAL — human-agreement rate for the criterion (feeds loss_vector.criterion_loss = 1-R_human).

thresholds.description: Optional overrides of DEFAULT_THRESHOLDS. Any omitted key keeps its default.

conflict_delta.description: weighted child-value stdev >= this in a material branch -> inconclusive(conflict:<branch>)

residual_cap.description: Σ J-leaf flow >= this -> judgment_dominated + inconclusive

materiality.description: advisory prune threshold (applied in the skill, not the script)

material_branch_flow.description: a branch counts for conflict-detection when its global flow >= this

depth_cap.description: max root->leaf path depth; deeper -> SpecError (over-decomposition)

nodes.description: The DAG. Exactly one node has no parents (the root). Shared sub-concepts have multiple parents. No cycles.

kind.description: a node with no children is treated as a leaf even if kind is omitted

parents.description: incoming edges; empty ONLY for the single root

weight.description: relative weight under that parent; siblings are normalized to sum 1

leaf_type.description: LEAF only. D=deterministic-measurable, T=typeable/observable, J=bounded-calibrated-judgment (last resort; requires a stated 'why not D/T')

value.description: LEAF only. graded [0,1] membership (Zadeh), never a raw boolean

confidence.description: LEAF only. how sure the measurement/judge is (propagated to aggregate_confidence)

raw.description: LEAF: the raw observation, e.g. '82%', '190/200 pass', '1 critical CVE'

method.description: LEAF: how the value was obtained (tool, count, rubric)

anchors.description: LEAF: REQUIRED. positive+negative reference points that ground the [0,1] scale. An anchorless leaf is refused (disguised guessing).

boundary.description: optional held-out boundary exemplar for validation (Step 7)

$comment: OUTPUT (aggregate_spec.py): {construct, score, band(HIGH|MEDIUM|LOW), aggregate_confidence, leaf_flows{id:flow Σ=1}, contributions[{id,leaf_type,flow,value,contrib}], sensitivity[{pivot,delta_to_flip,flips_to}], residual{j_weight,judgment_dominated}, inconclusive{flag,reasons[]}}. reasons ∈ low_confidence|judgment_dominated|conflict:<branch>. Exit: 0 ok, 2 unreadable, 3 SpecError(refused).
